hero.description: I craft immersive web experiences and scalable web applications using React, Next.js, Vue.js, Nuxt.js, and Three.js.

chapters.body: Started as a kid who couldn't leave a UI alone without adding one more animation. Now I break things on purpose — and fix them 40ms faster every time.
I live inside the 16ms budget. WebGL shaders, scroll choreography, magnetic cursors — the layer most developers call polish is where I spend most of my time.
Currently crafting immersive digital products in Dubai. Looking for ambitious projects where the bar is set by the work — not the brief.

items.title: 3D Vehicle Configurator — Magnite
items.description: Real-time 3D car configurator built with Three.js And Babylon.js. Users customize colors, accessories, and environments — with AR viewing — entirely in the browser, no plugin required.

items.title: Automotive Microsites — GCC Campaigns
items.description: Series of high-impact campaign microsites deployed across GCC markets — cinematic scroll animations, multilingual support, and market-specific performance tuning.

items.title: Automotive E-Commerce Platform
items.description: Full-featured e-commerce system for automotive parts — search, filtering, cart, and checkout — built for performance and cross-browser reliability.

items.title: Creative Studio Website
items.description: Agency website for Alternative built around 3D visual storytelling and immersive motion. Every section designed to hold attention and communicate craft.

items.title: SaaS Accounting Platform — Fatoorah
items.description: Arabic-first marketing site for a multi-tenant SaaS invoicing platform. Focused on clarity, conversion, and building trust with regional business audiences.

items.title: Certified Pre-Owned Listings Platform
items.description: Vehicle listing platform for Nissan's certified pre-owned inventory — streamlined browsing, smart filtering, and a UX built around purchase confidence.

items.title: Marketing Landing Page — MBR
items.description: Premium landing page with layered scroll animations and a confident visual identity. Built to convert, designed to make an impression.

_experienceBullets._note: Improved bullets for CV / about section — same facts, sharper framing
alternative: Led frontend architecture across enterprise CMS and e-commerce platforms for Ford and Nissan, shipping across 6+ international markets on schedule.
Designed a scalable microfrontend architecture in Next.js and React — enabling independent team deployments and cutting cross-team friction significantly.
Delivered SSR/SSG-powered sites with GSAP animation pipelines, lifting page load speed by 30%+ and organic SEO visibility by 20%+.
Built Nissan's Magnite 3D configurator in Babylon.js with AR, multi-angle cameras, and real-time customization — measurably increasing session depth.
Designed and shipped an internal Digital Asset Management platform for Nissan — role-based access, metadata tagging, and multi-market media delivery.
Replaced 8-hour manual deployments with Docker + GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines, cutting release time to under 5 minutes.
Mentored 3+ junior developers, established code review standards, and architected reusable patterns that improved long-term team velocity.
accura: Delivered 15+ production web applications across SaaS, e-commerce, dashboards, and marketing — all mobile-first and cross-browser.
Built the Fatoorah multi-tenant SaaS dashboard in React.js — covering inventory, POS, warehouses, and buyer/seller management.
Consistently cut load times by 30%+ through code-splitting, lazy loading, and disciplined caching strategies.
blink: Built responsive, accessible UI components in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and React — working directly with designers and backend engineers to hit pixel-perfect results.
